headline: US Oil Industry Profits Exceed $130 Billion During Iran Conflict
summary: The U.S. oil producing and refining industry earned over $130 billion in profit during the Iran war. The figure is nearly triple the amount earned by the sector during the same period in 2025.
why: U.S. oil producers and refiners represent a major segment of global energy supply and corporate earnings in capital markets.

impacts.name: US Energy Sector
impacts.why: U.S. oil producers and refiners reported profits of over $130 billion during the period.
